description: The complete Morocco income tax computation for 2026, as on the return. Covers: Barème 2025 (0% to 40,000, top 37%) and the 600 family reduction per dependant (max 3,600) from LF 2026; Salary: frais professionnels for every profession, CNSS with its ceiling, AMO, CIMR, group insurance, social-home loans, CFC 20% or barème; Pensions: basic and CIMR group pensions exempt, 70%/40% abatement, 80% reduction for foreign pensions transferred in dirhams; Rents: 40% abatement and barème, or the 20% final option, withholding credited; Dividends 11.25%, interest 30% (20% credited for professionals), foreign investment income 15% with the foreign tax credit; and more. Returns the tax, the balance still to pay or to be refunded after taxes already paid, every option the law offers compared, and each step with its legal reference. All amounts in MAD; everything is optional, give only what applies. What is not modelled is listed in the result.

inputSchema.description: An individual's income tax return (impôt sur le revenu) for Morocco, tax year 2026 (calendar year). Every amount is in dirhams for the whole year; leave out what does not apply.

age.description: Age at the end of 2026. Default 40

activity.description: commerce (trade, industry, crafts) or services. Default services

cpu_coefficient.description: CPU coefficient of the profession, 0.03 to 0.45 (e.g. 0.10). Default 0.10

management_centre.description: Member of an approved management centre (centre de gestion agréé): 15% abatement under RNS

regime.description: none, rnr (résultat net réel), rns (résultat net simplifié), cpu (contribution professionnelle unique), auto_entrepreneur. Default none

single_client_excess.description: Services turnover above 80,000 from one client (withheld at 30% by that client), dirhams (MAD) for 2026

turnover.description: Turnover excluding VAT (cashed, for auto-entrepreneurs), dirhams (MAD) for 2026

children.description: Children (own or legally taken in) aged 27 or under, or disabled, with income of 40,000 or less. Default 0

donations.description: Donations to approved bodies, dirhams (MAD) for 2026

mortgage_interest.description: Interest (or Mourabaha / Ijara margin) on a loan for your main home (max 10% of global income), dirhams (MAD) for 2026

retirement_insurance.description: Individual retirement insurance premiums (contracts of 8 years or more, paid from age 45), dirhams (MAD) for 2026

income.description: Foreign salary, business or rental income, gross, dirhams (MAD) for 2026

tax.description: Foreign tax paid on it in a treaty country, dirhams (MAD) for 2026

dividends.description: Moroccan dividends (11.25% withheld, final), dirhams (MAD) for 2026

exempt.description: Exempt savings income (Caisse d'épargne nationale, PEL, PEE, PEA within their conditions), dirhams (MAD) for 2026

foreign_income.description: Foreign dividends and interest, gross (15% final, residents), dirhams (MAD) for 2026

foreign_income_tax.description: Foreign tax paid on that foreign investment income, dirhams (MAD) for 2026

interest.description: Moroccan interest and sukuk income (30% final; 20% credited for business taxpayers under RNR/RNS), dirhams (MAD) for 2026

interest_withheld.description: 20% withheld on interest of business taxpayers (RNR/RNS), dirhams (MAD) for 2026

filing_days.description: Days the return is filed after the deadline (1 March or 1 May 2027). Default 0

payment_days.description: Days the balance is paid after the deadline. Default 0

married.description: Married: the spouse counts as a dependant (personne à charge) for the family reduction

final_taxes_withheld.description: The final taxes normally withheld at source were withheld (dividends, interest, listed securities, 20% rents, CFC salary, single-client excess). Default true

other.description: Other payments already made for 2026, dirhams (MAD) for 2026

amo.description: AMO and similar contributions withheld from the taxable pensions, dirhams (MAD) for 2026

complementary.description: Other complementary pensions and annuities, Moroccan source, dirhams (MAD) for 2026

exempt.description: Basic-scheme pensions (CMR, RCAR, CNSS) and CIMR group-contract pensions: exempt from 2026, dirhams (MAD) for 2026

foreign_transferred_share.description: Share of the foreign pension transferred for good in non-convertible dirhams, 0 to 1 (80% tax reduction on that part). Default 0

withheld.description: Income tax withheld on pensions, dirhams (MAD) for 2026

property.description: Sales of real estate in Morocco (at most 20)

acquisition_costs.description: Purchase costs (flat 15% of the price is used when lower), dirhams (MAD) for 2026

acquisition_price.description: Purchase price (or value at inheritance), dirhams (MAD) for 2026

coefficient.description: Revaluation coefficient for the year bought (DGI table). Default 1

investments.description: Construction, renovation and improvement works, dirhams (MAD) for 2026

loan_interest.description: Interest paid on the purchase loan, dirhams (MAD) for 2026

main_home.description: Main home occupied 5 years or more (or a Moroccan abroad's home in Morocco): exempt, 3% minimum on the price above 4,000,000

sale_costs.description: Selling costs (agency, ads, deeds), dirhams (MAD) for 2026

social_home.description: Social home (logement social) occupied 4 years or more: exempt

gross.description: Gross rents from private individuals (no withholding), dirhams (MAD) for 2026

gross_withheld.description: Gross rents paid by companies, public bodies or professionals (withholding at source, retenue à la source), dirhams (MAD) for 2026

opt_final_20.description: Opted for the 20% final rate on the rents withheld at source (instead of the barème with a 40% abatement)

withheld.description: 10% / 15% withheld by tenants (not final), when not on the 20% option, dirhams (MAD) for 2026

residency.description: Tax residence (domicile fiscal): resident (home or centre of interests in Morocco, or more than 183 days) is taxed on worldwide income; non_resident only on Moroccan income. Default resident

benefits.description: Benefits in money or in kind (avantages en argent ou en nature), dirhams (MAD) for 2026

cfc.description: Employee of a Casablanca Finance City company (20% final rate for up to 10 years)

cfc_bareme.description: CFC employee who opted for the progressive scale (barème) instead of 20%

cimr.description: CIMR or other group supplementary pension contributions taken from pay (deductible up to 50% of net salary), dirhams (MAD) for 2026

gross.description: Gross taxable pay in money, without exempt items (meal vouchers up to 40 a day, etc.), dirhams (MAD) for 2026

group_insurance.description: Employee share of group insurance premiums (illness, invalidity, death), dirhams (MAD) for 2026

other_health.description: Health and social contributions (AMO, mutuelle), when social_scheme is none, dirhams (MAD) for 2026

other_pension.description: Pension contributions to other Moroccan schemes (CMR, RCAR), when social_scheme is none, dirhams (MAD) for 2026

profession.description: Professional expenses rate (frais professionnels): general (35% when gross taxable income incl. benefits is 78,000 or less, else 25% max 35,000; applied to pay without benefits), casino (25%), printerMinerArtist (35%), journalistRepCrew (45%: journalists, life-insurance agents, sales reps, flight crew), merchantNavy (40%). Default general

social_housing_loan.description: Principal and interest repaid on a loan for a social home (logement social) used as main home, dirhams (MAD) for 2026

social_scheme.description: cnss: private sector, CNSS 4.48% up to 6,000 a month and AMO 2.26% computed (default); none: enter your contributions below (civil servants: CMR, RCAR...)

withheld.description: Income tax withheld by the employer (IR retenu à la source), dirhams (MAD) for 2026

securities.description: Sales of shares, bonds and funds (profits de capitaux mobiliers)

foreign_tax.description: Foreign tax paid on foreign securities gains, dirhams (MAD) for 2026

losses_brought_forward.description: Securities losses of the last 4 years not yet used (set against unlisted shares and bonds first), dirhams (MAD) for 2026

cost.description: Weighted average purchase cost incl. purchase fees, dirhams (MAD) for 2026

kind.description: listedShares (listed shares, equity funds: 15%), other (unlisted shares, other funds: 20%), bonds (bonds and other debt securities: 20%), foreign (foreign securities: 20%). Losses offset only gains of the same nature (shares or debt)
